name: ASP Isotopes

verdict.label: Speculative
verdict.oneLine: A small South African isotope and helium company with real plants, heavy dilution and several business lines that are still promises.

summary: ASP Isotopes separates isotopes in Pretoria, owns a helium field in South Africa's Free State through Renergen, and wants to make HALEU fuel for next-generation reactors. The film covers what it actually owns, who runs it and whether insiders are buying, the cash, burn, runway, dilution and book value, every business line ranked from most real to most speculative, the risks, and three scenarios. Short-seller claims mentioned in the film are allegations that the company disputes.
disclosure: Matt does not own shares of ASP Isotopes and was not paid by anyone to make this video.
change: First page, built from the October 2026 deep-dive film. Figures have not been refreshed since Oct 20, 2026.
